summary: Spec fidelity [INFERENCE from the code, the seeded startNoWait case proves only the missing-wait direction]: L2.async 'start-next-waits' (safety.rs:399) requires the literal word --wait in meta.next[0].argv. Spec 13.2 says next leads with 'the command that reads or waits for the outcome' and 13.3 only says a waiting command SHOULD take --wait, so a tool whose next[0] is a status read (or a wait written another way) is failed by a MUST row for a SHOULD convention. checker.md says 'next[0] waits' and does not say how a wait is recognised: ATIP question. Same family: the timeout run adds --timeout 1s only when the command document has a timeout option (safety_plan.rs:247).
